reason: The shortage problem is real and my meeting eats time every week, but I'm not sending open PO lines and job data to an early-stage company I've never heard of. Pulling clean exports means my planner loses a day, and IT or the CFO would want to know who has our data before anyone signs off.
objection: A free audit that ends with 'which of these did your team already know about?' reads like a sales pitch dressed up as a favor. I've been burned by consultants who told me what I already knew, and I'd have to hand over our supplier and job data to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from another Epicor Kinetic shop of my size that I can call, plus a sample report run on dummy or last year's data so I can see the output before exposing live jobs.
